第1372章 接受审判（第1页）
“这一场热闹，让老身也来凑凑，如何？”
“唉，一把老骨头，是时候要活动活动一番。”
只见，一个老太婆头发发白，身穿着一袭金丝玉缕而成的端庄旗袍缓缓踏空走出，手中拄着一根龙头拐杖。
举手投足之间无不散发着优雅和慈祥的气息。
贪寰神色阴沉，这是人族这边又出现了一位圣王境强者？！
这些老东西，可真的是一个个都疯了不成？！
平日里在那剑气长城上都不曾见过这些人的面孔。
看见老妪的出现，太华美眸微眯，随后脑海中迅速闪过一个人。
“姓游？”众人眼神微眯，大致也是猜测出了老妪的真实身份。
“这一位，莫非是四大巨头之一，宝龙商行游氏一脉的老祖？”陵霄微微猜测道。
“游前辈，倒是没有想到，您能亲自前来！”此刻，慕容复都是有些惊讶连连。
要知道，宝龙商行万年以来，素来都是不插手任何势力的事，始终保持着中立的态度，除非是在人族生死存亡的时候才会出手。
游老妪一一扫过诸位圣王境强者，微微颔首，随后便是锁定在了齐长风身上，笑着道：
“道宫这些年，倒是尽数出风流人杰。”
“老身那小丫头可是吵着闹着要见叶平安和柳姑娘呢。”
众人闻言心头都是一惊，原来游氏这位老祖是因为叶平安那小子的缘故而来。
“还有前面的这位风清扬，应该也是奔着叶平安和道宫而来的吧？”毕竟，生前，风清扬似乎和齐长风还有过一段交情。

这边，九位魔神的脸色纷纷阴沉了下去。
”索斯，情况不对，人族这些老怪物，都疯了，竟不惜一切代价插手此地之事。”
“尽管再来一位圣王境，战局还是对我们倾斜。”
“太华四人不过是强弩之末，只需让痴离一人对付即可。”
“那风清扬便交给我，剩余的慕容复和这老太婆两人，你们七个在最短时间内解决掉！”
商量之后，索斯便是丝毫不废话，全身滔天的魔神之力轰然爆发，魔神道躯手中斧刃遮天蔽日夹杂着恐怖毁灭之力朝着风清扬横扫而去。
“诸位，我们这些老东西难得聚在一起，可别让别人看不起才是啊。”游老妪手中拐杖轰然堕地，震荡之际，身上的气息焕然新生！
恐怖的气血之力覆盖全身，仿佛年轻了数千岁，身材妙曼轻盈，肤如凝脂。
一件件品级高到离谱的元器从她手中施展出，爆发出无尽的威力，一时间，竟是能在短时间内缠住了四位魔神级别的存在！
另外的慕容复则是独自对上了三位魔神。
无尽恐怖的波动在天地棋盘内迸发，每一次的碰撞，所迸发出的余波，甚至是足矣将一方疆域尽数摧毁！
战斗逐渐进入白热化，下方李纯众人则是神色逐渐变得不太好，一抹抹浓郁的担忧浮现。
“不行，如此下去，老祖他们必然不是对手。”

Chapter 1372 Accepting the Trial (Page 1)
"How about I join in on this fun?"
"Oh, you are an old bone, it's time to get some exercise."
I saw an old woman with white hair, wearing a dignified cheongsam made of gold and jade threads, slowly walking out of the air, holding a dragon-headed crutch in her hand.
Every gesture exudes elegance and kindness.
Tanhuan's expression was gloomy. Is this another strong man in the Holy King realm appearing on the human race? !
Are these old people really crazy? !
I have never seen the faces of these people on the Sword Qi Great Wall.
Seeing the appearance of the old woman, Taihua's beautiful eyes narrowed slightly, and then a person quickly flashed in his mind.
"Your surname is You?" Everyone narrowed their eyes, roughly guessing the old woman's true identity.
"Could this person be one of the four giants, the ancestor of the You family of Baolong Trading Company?" Ling Xiao guessed slightly.
"Senior You, I didn't expect that you could come in person!" At this moment, Murong Fu was a little surprised.
You must know that Baolong Trading Company has never intervened in the affairs of any force for thousands of years, and has always maintained a neutral attitude, unless it takes action when the survival of the human race is at stake.
Old Woman You swept over all the Saint King Realm experts one by one, nodded slightly, then locked on Qi Changfeng, and said with a smile:
"In the past few years, the Dao Palace has produced many outstanding people."
"That little girl is clamoring to see Ye Pingan and Miss Liu."
Everyone was shocked when they heard this. It turned out that the ancestor of the You family came because of that boy Ye Pingan.
"And the Feng Qingyang in front of him, he should also be here for Ye Pingan and Dao Palace, right?" After all, Feng Qingyang seemed to have had a relationship with Qi Changfeng before his death.
Here, the faces of the nine demon gods turned gloomy.
"Soth, something is wrong. These old monsters from the human race are crazy and want to interfere in the affairs of this place at all costs."
"Even though there is another Saint King, the battle situation is still tilted towards us."
"Taihua and the other four are just weaklings. We only need Chili to deal with them alone."
"Leave Feng Qingyang to me. The remaining two, Murong Fu and this old woman, you seven will deal with them in the shortest possible time!"
After the discussion, Soth didn't talk nonsense at all, and the overwhelming power of the demon god exploded all over his body. The ax blade in the demon god's body covered the sky and the sun, and swept towards Feng Qingyang with the power of terror and destruction.
"Everyone, it's rare for old people like us to get together, so don't let others look down on us." The crutch in Old Woman You's hand suddenly fell to the ground. When she was shaken, the aura on her body was renewed!
The terrifying power of Qi and blood covers the whole body, as if he is thousands of years younger, with a graceful and light figure, and skin like gelatin.
Elements of ridiculously high grade were unleashed from her hands, bursting out with endless power. In one moment, she was able to entangle four demon god-level beings in a short period of time!
The other Murong Fu faced the three demon gods alone.
Endless terrifying fluctuations burst out in the chessboard of heaven and earth. The aftermath of every collision is enough to completely destroy a territory!
The battle gradually became intense, and the expressions of Li Chun and others below gradually became less good, with traces of strong worry emerging.
"No, if this continues, Ancestor and the others will definitely be no match for us."
